title: New certificate required.
officialText:
The following changes to a place of assembly shall require a new place of assembly
certificate of operation instead of an amendment filed in accordance with section 28-117.1.3:
1. For a department issued place of assembly permit or place of assembly certificate of operation that does not have a nine-digit
job number, any change of zoning use group, assembly occupancy group A-1 through A-5, or any of the changes set forth in
section 28-117.1.3.
2. For all other department issued place of assembly permits or place of assembly certificates of operation, any change of zoning
use group or assembly occupancy group A-1 through A-5.
